newsitem.title: USA: Seagate Technology debt deal upped in size.
newsitem.headline: Seagate Technology debt deal upped in size.

text.p: Seagate Technology Inc's multi-tranche debt offering was increased in size for the second time on Thursday to meet investor demand, market sources said.
The deal was increased to $700 million and a fourth tranche with a 20-year maturity was added to the offering, syndicate sources said.
The initial $450 million size was upped to $500 million earlier on Thursday as investor interest picked up.
Currently, the deal stands as follows, sources said:
-- $200 million seven-year notes, price talk 65-70 basis points
-- $200 million 10-year debt, price talk 77-80 basis points
-- $200 million 40-year with put option in 12th year, price talk 85-90 basis points
